summary_bullets: Added a standalone /design plan revision waterfall that launches Codex, Cursor, then Claude with a composed prompt file and unconditional lib-quiet KV status output.
Implemented canonical plan-path validation, unified-diff/file-replacement candidate validation, snapshot restore, heading preservation, and ACTION=EMIT_PLAN gating.
Added sibling docs plus a fully mocked eleven-case harness covering promotion, validation, revert, prompt-source, and argv failure contracts, wired into Makefile and test-harnesses-9.
commit_message:
Add standalone design plan revision waterfall

Introduce revise-plan-with-waterfall.sh for between-round /design plan revisions with Codex -> Cursor -> Claude fallback, canonical plan validation, snapshot restore, heading preservation, and emit-plan gating. Add sibling docs and an offline mocked harness, then wire the target into Makefile shard 9.
